chunks: And from a sermon of him (peace be upon him), in which he gives advice and encourages detachment from the world.
ai.seo_question: What is the theme of Imam Ali's sermon regarding the world?
ai.summary: In this sermon from *Nahj al-Balagha*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) employs vivid imagery to illustrate the transient nature of the world, urging believers to view it as a temporary resting place rather than a permanent home. This teaching aligns with the Shia tradition of *zuhd* (asceticism), which emphasizes inner detachment and readiness for the Hereafter over material accumulation. The counsel serves as a spiritual corrective to worldly attachment, reinforcing the inevitability of death as a transition to eternal life.
